owner: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) / WIOCC Group
notes: OADC Durban DUR1 at Arbour Junction 2, Arbour Road, Amanzimtoti (20km south of Durban CBD, eThekwini) - carrier-neutral Tier III-designed facility, 4,200 sq m with ~2,000 sq m IT white space; went live April 2022 with 4MW power capacity; serves as the Durban landing station for the 2Africa subsea cable (landed by WIOCC, one of 2Africa's four SA landings: Yzerfontein, Duynefontein, Gqeberha, Amanzimtoti). OADC hyperscale page confirms landing-station DC role.
